attestations.exit_criteria: document a commercial Gurobi entitlement and production deployment authorization
attestations.evidence_boundary: a redacted authorization record is required; license credentials must never be committed

attestations.exit_criteria: deploy behind approved IAM/RBAC, TLS termination, secret management, audit retention, and network controls
attestations.evidence_boundary: an approved architecture and deployment verification record are required

attestations.exit_criteria: approve source data lineage, calibrate recovery/yield/cost assumptions, and complete backtesting with governed plant data
attestations.evidence_boundary: plant data must be governed and its validation record must be independently reviewable

attestations.exit_criteria: measure and approve realized service, cost, recovery, emissions, and circularity outcomes against a controlled baseline
attestations.evidence_boundary: benefits must be measured against an approved baseline; synthetic projections do not qualify

claim_boundary: This validator checks evidence references, hashes, and approval metadata. It cannot independently establish the truth of an external authorization, security approval, plant-data result, or business-benefit claim.
